note: Settings the gate uses when no flag is given. They are first settings chosen for mstack, not measured values. Change them with the flags of gate.py, and write the reason next to your baseline.

min_trials.source: mstack default: one run of a model cannot tell a real change from chance, three is the smallest count that shows a case is unstable
min_trials.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

min_cases.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

max_drop.unit: pass rate (0 to 1) the candidate may lose before the gate fails
max_drop.source: mstack default, first setting; set it with the owner of the evaluation set
max_drop.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

pass_score.unit: score at or above which a trial with a score and no pass field counts as passed
pass_score.source: mstack default; depends on the grader, so set it per evaluation set
pass_score.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number
